summary: Frontend-only regression completed on public preview URL. Customer /demo gateway, /demo/workspace separation, investor-only /investor flow, legacy redirects, customer/investor film routes, responsive behavior, reduced-motion behavior, kinetic ecosystem counts/motion, and global unaffected routes were validated. One minor console warning appears during reduced-motion mode from framer-motion troubleshooting output.

integration_issues.issue: Console prints a framer-motion warning when reduced-motion is enabled: 'You have Reduced Motion enabled on your device. Animations may not appear as expected.'

action_items: (Optional) Suppress or handle the framer-motion reduced-motion warning if strict console-clean policy is required.
No functional regressions found for requested /demo, /demo/workspace, /investor separation and route flow requirements.
critical_code_review_comments: Routing split is correctly implemented: /demo (customer selector), /demo/workspace (full explorer), /investor (investor-only gateway), and legacy /investor/customer redirects preserve query params.
Header active-state logic correctly scopes Watch demo to /demo descendants and Investors to /investor descendants.

Kinetic ecosystem wiring is consistent with requested inventory: 50 capabilities, 36 tools, 48 connectors; compact mode toggles after problem step; reduced-motion halts continuous lane/core transforms.
Progressive selector flow is step-replacement based (single visible step), with working Previous navigation, filtering, suggestion shortcuts, and URL persistence for problem/role/department/industry.
All six film routes (venture/strategic/operator + executive/technical/workflow) load live MacBook iframe stages with 5-scene rails and both booking/waitlist CTAs present.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated desktop, tablet (768x1024), and mobile (390x844) on public URL. Confirmed no horizontal overflow on tested pages, reduced-motion static behavior, and full route split behavior. Legacy investor customer redirects are healthy. If strict console-cleanliness is enforced, verify whether the reduced-motion warning should be suppressed.
rca of the issue: Minor RCA (console-only): framer-motion emits an informational warning when reduced-motion is enabled to explain disabled animations. Reproduction: emulate reduced motion and load /demo; warning appears in browser console. Mitigation: keep as-is (expected informational warning) or add conditional log filtering/wrapper policy if zero-warning console is a hard acceptance gate.
